const list = document.getElementById("items");
const empty = document.getElementById("empty");
const message = document.getElementById("message");
let items = [];
let revisions = {};

function render() {
  list.replaceChildren(
    ...items.map((item) => {
      const row = document.createElement("li");
      row.className = item.done ? "done" : "";
      const box = document.createElement("input");
      box.type = "checkbox";
      box.checked = item.done;
      box.id = `item-${item.id}`;
      const label = document.createElement("label");
      label.htmlFor = box.id;
      const text = document.createElement("span");
      text.textContent = item.quantity > 1 ? `${item.title} (${item.quantity})` : item.title;
      label.append(text);
      box.addEventListener("change", () => toggle(item, box.checked));
      row.append(box, label);
      return row;
    }),
  );
  empty.hidden = items.length > 0;
}

async function load() {
  const { data, revisions: known } = await tessera.call("data.read");
  items = data.items ?? [];
  revisions = known.items ?? {};
  render();
}

async function change(operations, done) {
  try {
    await tessera.call("data.patch", { operations });
    await load();
    message.textContent = done;
  } catch (error) {
    message.textContent = `That didn't work: ${error.message}`;
  }
}

document.getElementById("add").addEventListener("submit", (event) => {
  event.preventDefault();
  const form = event.target;
  const title = form.item.value.trim();
  if (!title) return;
  const quantity = Math.max(1, Number(form.quantity.value) || 1);
  change([{ op: "add", collection: "items", record: { title, quantity, done: false } }], `${title} is on the list.`);
  form.reset();
  form.item.focus();
});

function toggle(item, done) {
  change(
    [{ op: "replace", collection: "items", id: item.id, revisionCount: revisions[item.id], fields: { done } }],
    done ? `${item.title} is ticked.` : `${item.title} is back on the list.`,
  );
}

document.getElementById("clear").addEventListener("click", () => {
  const ticked = items.filter((item) => item.done);
  if (ticked.length === 0) return (message.textContent = "Nothing is ticked yet.");
  change(
    ticked.map((item) => ({ op: "remove", collection: "items", id: item.id, revisionCount: revisions[item.id] })),
    `Removed ${ticked.length} ticked items.`,
  );
});

load();
